summary: Certified MODEL-MODAL-VARIABLE-EFFECTS and MODEL-MODAL-FIXED-EFFECT both have a necessarily existing source, distinct existing causal relata, and some caused effect at every accessible world, but disagree on whether one rigid effect is present across all worlds; the selected effect is contingent only in the first model. Verified the fixed-effect-to-some-effect implication and a conditional impossibility core for disjoint effect sets. This refutes the quantifier shift, not the necessity of a real concrete cause, free choice, causal determinism or creation. See docs/modal-quantifier-shift-models.md and #462.
